scope: static audit (RTL + die.v connectivity) of every fixed-timing client of the d4g VM banks against hfd_vms_bank_native_q0_faces; not a simulation of each client

dies.GEN2c: /home/ubuntu/artifacts/hdie-d4/d4g_gen2c/pb/die.v (relays_d4f layer: every VM rq/rr lane carries relay stages, e.g. SU rf0444/rf0771 s002, x-load rf1420/rf0894 s012, COLL rf1375 s029 / rf0857 s030, IDX ctl rf1335/rf0817 k00_00)

bank_fact: all 32 banks = hfd_vms_bank_native_q0_faces (generated by ot_pin_regs.tcl): every input incl. rq0-4, wq0-1, dq, kq, xq, xq2, pq, rslot/wslot is captured by a literal pin flop before ot_vms_bank_q0_faces_core (= the n / n+6 body). Slots and requests share the flop, so calendar booking is unchanged, but EVERY read answer, write commit/done and hub echo is +1 edge vs ot_vms_bank_static (the model most clients were timed on: rq->rr n+6, commit n+3). Measured on the idxtk cut: TOPK hub echo W+11 vs W+10 (topk_finding.json). The VM hub (hfd_hgi_vms_glue*/static_core) already absorbs it (BANK_PIN_IN 1, COMMIT_DELAY, H-ELEM 10-17 01:33); its clients were not re-timed.
functional_bind_gap: d4g functional_bind (INJ/DEL/RC/SFUJ/DMA/HC/XCMD classes) checks connectivity and relay stage counts but NOT that each fixed-latency client's round-trip parameter equals bank pin flop + relay stages on its lane; GEN2c PASS with every client still at its non-face, zero-relay value.

recommendation: ONE die rule instead of per-client patches: every fixed-latency VM client gets its round trip from the die (bank pin 1 + relay stages per lane) as a strap/parameter, and the d4g functional bind gains a LATENCY class that fails when a client's parameter != pin + stages on its lane. Alternative (bank side, one master): fold the faces pin flop into the core's S1 so the bank is n+6 again -- re-close of a critical tile (hfd_vms_bank) and the hub BANK_PIN_IN reverts; coordinator decision.
